subject: UefiCpuPkg/ArmMmuLib: DEBUG_VERBOSE -> DEBUG_PAGING
reasons: Mechanical substitution of DEBUG_VERBOSE with DEBUG_PAGING inside a DEBUG() macro call

Part of a clearly identified multi-commit series: 939de47d12 adds DEBUG_PAGING definition, then 3d6453f515 (OvmfPkg), 5dc31efc42 (UefiCpuPkg/CpuDxe), e7ffbde9ad (UefiCpuPkg/ArmMmuLib), and af1ae393d0 (UefiCpuPkg/MpLib) all apply the same DEBUG_VERBOSE->DEBUG_PAGING substitution to paging-related debug messages across packages
The pattern is well-defined and purely structural: replace DEBUG_VERBOSE with DEBUG_PAGING in DEBUG() calls within paging-related code
High repetitiveness as 1-of-N in a series spanning multiple packages and files
candidate_pattern:
@@
expression msg, args;
@@
DEBUG((
- DEBUG_VERBOSE,
+ DEBUG_PAGING,
  msg, ##args))
